noDistrictAreas.devNote: Inside the Budapest outline but in no district polygon (also the Danube channels around it). Directly administered by the capital, so FÖRI is primary. IRM rendelet annex 1 point 5.13.2 "A Fővárosi Önkormányzat által közvetlenül igazgatott Margitsziget" (https://njt.jog.gov.hu/jogszabaly/2007-67-20-1U, state 2026-10-01) and the station's Ügyrend 5/2024. (XI. 26.) II. 4. (adatvedelem.police.hu). The water around the island is the Dunai Vízirendészeti Rendőrkapitányság's (4. § a)); the app still offers XIII there. Checked 2026-11-17 (researcher + sceptic, O8).

devNoteRules: capitalRoads = who handles parking (KRESZ stopping/waiting) enforcement on capital-managed roads in that district: fori | district | both (district on the listed districtActsOn sections, FÖRI elsewhere) | unknown. Resolver (SPEC 4.2): FÖRI is primary on every capital road unless the pin's road section is listed in districtActsOn. Entries with scope "narrower" cover only part of the decree row: the resolver keeps FÖRI primary there, lowers confidence and names the district body as the first alternative.
